---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new trading strategy, indicator, or infrastructure improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: big-main
---

## Summary

A one-line description of the feature.

## Motivation

Why is this useful? What problem does it solve or what edge does it add?

## Proposed Implementation

Describe how it should work. Include the target tokens, timeframes, entry/exit logic, and risk parameters if applicable.

## Backtesting Results (optional)

If you have tested this strategy, share the win rate, average R, and number of sample trades.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you considered and why this one is better.
